obligations.title: Conduct and maintain Privacy Impact Assessments for personal-data processing
obligations.summary: A PIC or PIP processing personal data should maintain a Privacy Impact Assessment covering the processing lifecycle and update it when material processing, regulatory, contractual, feature, or processor changes occur.

obligations.title: Maintain a Privacy Management Program
obligations.summary: A PIC or PIP should maintain an organizational privacy management program with leadership responsibility, a control framework, continuous improvement, and periodic privacy/data-protection training.

obligations.title: Integrate privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default into data-processing systems
obligations.source_locator: NPC Circular 2023-06 Sections 7-8; NPC Advisory 2025-02 provides lifecycle guidance
obligations.summary: For applicable data-processing systems, privacy safeguards should be considered in system design and only data necessary for the stated processing purpose should be enabled by default.

obligations.title: Document and periodically review personal-data retention periods
obligations.source_locator: NPC Circular 2023-06 Section 9; Data Privacy Act Section 11
obligations.summary: Personal data should not be retained longer than necessary for its lawful purpose, and the organization should document, periodically review, and update retention periods.

obligations.title: Restrict personal-data access to authorized personnel with appropriate controls
obligations.summary: Access to personal data should be restricted to authorized personnel on a need-to-know basis, governed by access-control procedures and appropriate authentication mechanisms for applicable online access.

obligations.title: Maintain and periodically test business-continuity measures for personal data
obligations.summary: A PIC or PIP should maintain business-continuity planning that addresses personal-data backup, restoration and remedial time and is periodically reviewed and tested.
